column1: # Babi Lighthouse: workers, injured guards, Sheba's rescue, the sealed door and the ruins.

column3: It seems to be locked.{end_wait}
No order to resume work.\nPerhaps we have been given\na day to catch our breath.{end_wait}
Strangers entered the\nruins. Faran followed\nthem inside.{end_wait}

Babi chose a strange
place for his lighthouse.{page_break}Perhaps the old ruins
made a convenient
foundation.{end_wait}

Cutting and hauling
these stones is hard
work.{page_break}If Babi wants it built
faster, he can come
and lift them himself.{end_wait}

There was a fight here.
Some people were taken
afterward.{page_break}A terrible business,
but at least the work
has stopped for now.{end_wait}

If Faran followed them,
this is serious.{page_break}If the trouble spreads,
we may never finish
the lighthouse.{end_wait}

Why force the work to
move so quickly?{page_break}Perhaps Babi wants more
than a beacon. Perhaps
he seeks power at sea.{end_wait}
Now that I remember,\nthere was a strange cave\nin the quarry.{end_wait}
They were{pause_20_skippable} terrifying.\nWe never stood a chance\nagainst them.{end_wait}

Only two of the six
actually fought us...{page_break}but those two were
strong enough to drive
all of us back.{end_wait}
They shoved us aside\nand continued toward\nthe lighthouse.{end_wait}

They burned everything
in their path. The ground
is still blackened.{page_break}Fire used against the
helpless is the mark
of a coward.{end_wait}

We started the fight,
but we were the ones
left broken.{page_break}What possessed us to
challenge people like
that?{end_wait}
The other four barely\nraised a hand. They\nseemed unwilling to fight.{end_wait}
What are they planning\nto do at Babi Lighthouse?\nWhy come here at all?{end_wait}

None of them carried
a torch.{page_break}The fire appeared from
nowhere. I still cannot
explain it.{end_wait}
You're certain they\npassed through this door?{end_wait}
Well? Does the door open?{end_wait}
Oh! Iodem...{end_wait}
Faran!{end_wait}
Will you go for us?{end_wait}
I am trusting you,\n{actor_name:1}. Open the door\nand prove I was right.{end_wait}

When I saw them, they
were already beyond the
door.{page_break}I swear it is true.
You have to believe me!{end_wait}

I'm sorry, but even
{actor_name:7} has never passed
through this door.{page_break}No one has ever found
a way to open it.{end_wait}
If you open this door,\nI will trust Iodem\nonce more.{end_wait}

I do not doubt you,
{actor_name:1}, but I fear
what waits beyond.{page_break}If this door stays shut,
we may lose her.{end_wait}

No one believes this door
can be opened. I am
starting to doubt it too.{page_break}I never saw them pass
through. I only heard
what others claimed.{end_wait}
What are they waiting for?\nIf they can open the door,\nthey must do it now.{end_wait}

This waiting is useless.
If we do not find
{actor_name:7} soon,{page_break}her life may be lost
beyond that door.{end_wait}
I hope the door opens.\nI will believe it when\nI see it.{end_wait}
The door!{end_wait}
Hey, the door's closing!{end_wait}
Why did it close?{end_wait}
This is true...{end_wait}
Please, {actor_name:1}. Bring\n{actor_name:7} back to us.\nWe have no one else.{end_wait}
The door opened...\nI never thought I would\nsee this happen.{end_wait}

It takes courage to
walk into danger when
you know what waits.{page_break}We will remain here.
Return to us safely.{end_wait}

I want to know what
lies beyond this door.{page_break}When this is over, I
may go and see it
for myself.{end_wait}

I am not afraid of
danger, but I would only
stand in your way.{page_break}Bring {actor_name:7} home.
That is all we ask.{end_wait}

If {actor_name:7} is harmed,
Tolbi and Lalivero will
become enemies.{page_break}We must not let that
happen. Too many lives
would be lost.{end_wait}
If this door opens,\nperhaps the rest of the\nruins can be reached.{end_wait}

The creatures here are
nothing compared with
what waits below.{page_break}I am glad the warriors
will face that danger
instead of me.{end_wait}
This wait is pointless...{page_break}{actor_name:7}'s life is in\ndanger. If they do not\nfind her soon...{end_wait}

I will not hinder
{actor_name:7}'s rescue.{page_break}From here, the rest is
for those warriors
to decide.{end_wait}
The way opens to those\nwho can see beyond\nwhat their eyes reveal.{end_wait}
